flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck of OCMS)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/{ReductionController (response mapping), ReductionServiceImpl, helpers/ReductionPersistenceService, helpers/ReductionAuditService}, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsReduction/OcmsReducedOffenceAmount. ocmsadminui: no reduction screen or prompt. Everything else: no reduction code
note: Story status: Requirement given - Gen flow (1 point). The backend side exists: the reduction is written transactionally to VON (TS-RED, amount_payable), suspended_notice, reduced_offence_amount and the internet VON, then the API replies 'Reduction Success' (200) or a specific error (400/404/409/500/503). The prompt only reaches the caller (PLUS); no OCMS screen shows it, and the PLUS screen: cannot verify from repo. The persistence step is lowered to Sebagian because ticket OCMS-DF-2026-184 (Pending UAT Verification) concerns due_date_of_revival written in the same step; OCMS-DF-2026-072 (Closed, Prod deployed) already stores the pre-reduction amount_payable in the reduction table.
recommendation: Claim only partly: the success/failure response exists in the API, but the prompt to the officer depends on PLUS (not in the repo). URA/team confirmation and UAT of OCMS-DF-2026-184 are needed before a full claim.

steps.step: After the officer confirms, the reduction is saved in OCMS
steps.detail: applyReduction runs in one transaction (rollbackFor Exception, ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/helpers/ReductionPersistenceService.java:56-74): it updates VON to TS-RED with the new amount_payable and due_date_of_revival (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/helpers/ReductionPersistenceService.java:101-112), inserts suspended_notice (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/helpers/ReductionPersistenceService.java:127-140), inserts ocms_reduced_offence_amount with the pre-reduction amount_payable (OCMS-DF-2026-072, Closed, Prod deployed; ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/helpers/ReductionPersistenceService.java:156-173), then syncs the internet VON (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/helpers/ReductionPersistenceService.java:205-210; if the internet record is missing it only logs a warning, ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/helpers/ReductionPersistenceService.java:214-218). Lowered to Sebagian because OCMS-DF-2026-184 (Pending UAT Verification) concerns the due_date_of_revival written here (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/helpers/ReductionPersistenceService.java:104-106). Data content in an environment: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS prompts that the reduction is successful
steps.detail: The API replies "Reduction Success" with HTTP 200 (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/ReductionController.java:122, :166) to the caller (PLUS). A repeated request for a notice that is already TS-RED is also answered with success (idempotent) without writing again (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/ReductionServiceImpl.java:176-183). There is no prompt on an OCMS staff portal screen because no reduction screen exists; whether PLUS shows this message to the officer: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The officer knows if the reduction was not applied successfully
steps.detail: Failures are distinguished in the API: Invalid format/Missing data (400), Notice not found (404), Notice has been paid / Notice is not eligible (409), Reduction fail (500), System unavailable (503) (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/ReductionController.java:131-160, :164-184). A concurrent-update conflict (OptimisticLockingFailure) and database errors are returned as TechnicalError (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/ReductionServiceImpl.java:126-151). Like the success step, this reply goes to PLUS, not to a prompt on an OCMS screen; display to the officer: cannot verify from repo.
